title: One minute of the Oct-10 BTC tape
description: Array of ticks. Prices in raw HyperCore units (BTC: USD * 10). Notionals in USD. Keys are alphabetical on purpose: forge decodes JSON into structs in that order.

ask.description: raw L1 ask, reconstructed as mark + half the quiet spread

bid.description: raw L1 bid, reconstructed as mark - half the quiet spread

forcedBuyNtl.description: USD notional of forced buys (short liquidations) hitting the book this minute

forcedSellNtl.description: USD notional of forced sells (long liquidations) hitting the book this minute

mark.description: raw, VWAP of Hyperliquid BTC-PERP fills this minute

oracle.description: raw, Coinbase BTC-USD close (Hyperliquid's oracle is a CEX median)

spot.description: raw, Coinbase BTC-USD close; what inventory is marked at

takerNtl.description: USD notional of all aggressive flow this minute
